# payment-manual

> Generated by `scripts/docs-generate.ts` from `modules/payment-manual/registry-item.json` and its skill. Do not edit this file. Run `pnpm docs:generate` to update it.

A payment provider for bKash, Nagad, Rocket and bank transfers that staff confirm by hand.

## Install

```saasaloy-command task=add name=payment-manual
saasaloy add payment-manual
saasaloy env
pnpm install
```

1. Run `saasaloy add payment-manual --dry-run` to print the plan and write nothing. Check the files it writes and the modules it adds first.
2. Run `saasaloy add payment-manual --yes` to write the files.
3. Run `saasaloy env` to fill the environment values the new modules declare. With no terminal, pass each value as `--set KEY=VALUE`.
4. Run `pnpm install` to fetch the new dependencies.
5. This module ships no skill. Read the `payment` skill under [What your agent reads](payment.md#what-your-agent-reads) and follow it to use the module in your code.
